cycles.title: Continuous D4 Spatial-Symmetry x Sinkhorn Transfer on NUM05 Physics (SpatialSymSCDRNumV3)
cycles.hypothesis: Factorizing continuous 2D equivariance over the dihedral group D4 (8 rotations/reflections acting on both input (x, y) and output (dx, dy)) with inner 5x6 Sub-Stochastic Sinkhorn Soft-Exclusion and exact Rao-Blackwellized mixture marginal likelihood enables immediate transfer across simultaneous 2D spatial rotations/reflections and 5-action permutations (including partial novelty isolation) while preserving null restraint and disjoint parity.

pass_criteria.rot90_perm_ABA_phase2_vs_baselines: SpatialSymSCDRNumV3 Phase 2 MSE at least 3x lower than MultiBankSCDRNumV2 and NUM05_Native; Bank 0 byte-exact
pass_criteria.reflect_partial_ABA: SpatialSymSCDRNumV3 beats MultiBankSCDRNumV2 and NUM05_Native on Phase 2 MSE; familiar abstain < 0.15 and novel abstain > 0.75
pass_criteria.disjoint_ABA: SpatialSymSCDRNumV3 pooled MSE within +0.002 of NUM05_Native
pass_criteria.null_AAA: 0.0 false archives across all seeds and exact MSE parity with NUM05_Native
pass_criteria.rot270_perm_control: SpatialSymSCDRNumV3 cumulative reward at least +15% higher than both MultiBankSCDRNumV2 and Fresh_UCB

cycles.title: SpatialSymSCDRNumV3b: Mild Identity Prior on (bank, id) + Fast Novelty Cold-Start on Disjoint Worlds
cycles.hypothesis: Adding a mild diagonal prior (0.40 on r=a) exclusively for g=id and lowering the active_bank write gate from 0.30 to 0.15 during cold-start (active_events < 20) closes both the disjoint_ABA pooled MSE gap (within +0.002 of NUM05_Native) and Phase-3 return latency without degrading rot90_perm_ABA, reflect_partial_ABA, null_AAA, or rot270_perm_control.

cycles.title: SpatialSymSCDRNumV3c: Pre-Archive Contradiction Quarantine Buffer for Zero-Contamination Freezing
cycles.hypothesis: Quarantining pre-archive contradiction rows (instead of writing them into bank0 prior to archival) and replaying them into the hierarchical D4 x Sinkhorn filter upon archival prevents pre-freeze bank contamination and eliminates the disjoint_ABA cold-start gap to within +0.002 of NUM05_Native while preserving all D4 spatial-symmetry transfer gains.
